Ava: Quick sync — proposed scope for a compact 'lift-and-shift' on-prem packaging. High-level goals: minimal agent (no k8s), explicit customer-managed egress modes, in-place upgrade with <2m p95 downtime, and an airgapped/offline installer path. Need objections or :eyes: by EOD.

Sam: Clarify egress constraints: do we support source-IP passthrough or only NAT mapping in phase 1? Some customers demand IP preservation.

Priya: Draft launch criteria: 1) successful pilot at two customers (one NAT mode, one IP-preserved), 2) operator smoke tests green (see acceptance matrix), 3) docs + rollback playbook published, 4) telemetry explicitly opt-in and privacy sign-off. Also: no admin API schema changes at launch.

Diego: Packaging ops: offline installer should be a single tar.gz + detached signature (sha256 + GPG). Sample verify command: `gpg --verify agent.tar.gz.sig agent.tar.gz`. Installer must validate disk, user, and signature before unpack.

Sam: Enumerating network modes for docs: DIRECT (customer routes traffic to agent), RELAY (customer runs relay/proxy that agent talks to), RELAY+PIN (relay + egress IP pinning). Each mode has different rollback and L3 implications.

Lewis: KMS/HSM: airgap installs need importable encrypted key blobs and local rotation support. Acceptance test: import -> sign -> rotate -> verify with no outbound calls.

Emma: Rollout cadence proposal: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with auto-rollback if p50 latency regresses >200ms or error rate >0.5% over 5m. Require fallback to hosted-compatible model variant when local model fails.

Ava: Example agent.conf for ops doc:
```
# agent.conf (example)
mode = "agent"
egress = { type = "relay", address = "relay.example.local:443" }
upgrade_window = "2m"
telemetry = { enabled = false }
```

Priya: Security: telemetry MUST be opt-in for private deployments; any telemetry must be hashed/anonymized. Security will block launch if plaintext identifiers are emitted.

Diego: Action items from packaging side: produce offline-installer spec, signature verification flow, and `install.sh` stub that validates sig + checks free disk and user.

Emma: Define contractual rollback SLA: commit to <1h rollback window for major upgrades for private customers. Ops needs automation tooling to meet that.

Ava: Action items assigned: Priya -> draft launch criteria ticket + security checklist; Diego -> offline installer spec + GPG sig flow; Lewis -> KMS import/rotation acceptance tests; Sam -> network modes doc + topology diagrams & cheat sheet; Emma -> rollout/rollback runbook. Scheduling field-pilot sync Monday 10am.

ops-bot: PR #4823 created by Diego: add-offline-installer-spec (https://git.internal/r/4823) :white_check_mark:

Priya: +1 from security in-thread. Will escalate if telemetry is not opt-in or if signatures aren't verifiable.

Sam: FYI NetCorp asked for deterministic upgrade ordering across 4 edge proxies and source-IP preservation. Adding to pilot acceptance criteria.

Ava: Noted, adding NetCorp as pilot candidate and capturing deterministic-order requirement in rollout ticket.

Emma: Who owns rollback docs?

Ava: Ownership: Sam -> network diagrams & cheat sheet, Priya -> security/playbook, Emma -> rollout steps. Diego & Lewis -> test artifacts.

Sam: Will sketch diagrams and a one-pager for field ops. :+1:

Ava: If no objections by EOD we lock scope and open the RFC for launch criteria. :shipit:
